blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Davao City Rep. Paolo Duterte on Monday denied claims that he received suitcases allegedly containing cash delivered by a dismissed policeman and questioned the National Bureau of Investigation’s (NBI) authority to probe the accusation. Lawyer Peter Paul Danao said he submitted an affidavit to the NBI on behalf of Duterte. The sworn statement challenged the bureau’s legal jurisdiction to investigate Rodulfo Gracioso Jr.’s allegations of cash deliveries to the Duterte family, which the Davao City lawmaker described as “fairy tale concoctions.” “The defense submitted an Affidavit Ad Cautelam, a precautionary sworn statement intended to place Duterte’s denial on […]...
